title: I Tried Making Money Flipping Amazon Return Products (Full Unboxing Part II)

stated_problem.quote: OK, this business is so inefficient. It's unbelievable.
stated_problem.speaker: Host (name not stated)

idea.name: Buy Amazon return pallets and resell the products
idea.one_liner: Buy pallets of returned goods, assess and value each item, then resell items individually online or locally.
idea.customer: People buying individual household, garden, fitness and other consumer goods.
idea.offer: Returned goods resold individually, often at a discount to their stated retail or listing value.
idea.revenue_model: Resell pallet items individually; profit depends on what sells after pallet, listing, fee and other costs.

acquisition_channels.details: He plans to sell locally through Facebook Marketplace; the transcript also names online selling generally but does not specify other online marketplaces.
He says he will sell locally through garage sales.

ideas.delivery: Buy and handle pallets of Amazon returns, then manually unpack, identify, assess and value the items. He expects to discount and sell items individually, online or locally; some items may need testing, reassembly or cleaning.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK consumer rights and product safety duties may apply when reselling returned goods, especially electrical items; goods should be safe and accurately described. No subscription or employment agency model is described.
